description: This source file defines a service module for retrieving and aggregating Large Language Model (LLM) cost data by agent from MongoDB. It includes functions for resolving collection candidates based on environment variables and defaults, building aggregation pipelines for both flat and array schemas, and a fallback in-process aggregation method. The main exported function orchestrates collection selection, attempts database-level aggregation, and falls back to in-memory processing when necessary.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates()
methods.description: Determines MongoDB collection candidates to query based on environment variable 'LLM_EVENTS_COLLECTION' and default priorities, ensuring deduplication.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process documents with a flat schema, extracting various agent and cost fields, normalizing agents, and summing costs in USD while preserving display casing.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Creates an aggregation pipeline for documents with an Agents[] array schema, normalizing agent names and summing costs in USD.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Performs in-process aggregation over provided documents with Agents array schema, normalizing agent names, summing costs, and preserving display casing. Used as a fallback when database aggregation fails.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main async function to retrieve LLM cost aggregation by agent. It attempts database-side aggregation with multiple pipelines, and on failure, falls back to in-memory aggregation, returning an array of agent-cost summaries.
